resources.string: Preview hidden. Capture remains explicit; system camera indicators stay visible.
Available modes depend on this camera. Photos use on-device processing; no proprietary engine is included.
JPEG retains camera metadata when enabled. PNG/WebP strip metadata.
Manual panorama: capture 2–8 left-to-right slices with 20% overlap, keeping the horizon level. Stitching blends seams without automatic alignment.
Anyone with this token URL on your local network can view the camera. Sharing stops when this screen leaves the foreground.
Saved privately in Pictures/TelosHidden. Hidden album is excluded from the gallery and removed when Telos is uninstalled.
JPEG EXIF only. Adds a recent location fix, at most 10 minutes old with accuracy within 500 m, when available.
Capture when a face is detected
Foreground only. Captures at most once every 5 seconds. Motion uses changes in the preview and can react to lighting changes.
